input: Find churches that run weekly summer day camps (not just Vacation Bible School) for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Arden Seventh-day Adventist Church
candidates.note: FLAG Camp for ages 5–12 operated Monday–Friday, June 15–July 31, 2026.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Swannanoa
candidates.note: Summer Camp Alive offered free, separately registered weekly camps in July 2025 for children completing K4–5th grade, with full- and half-day options.

candidates.name: Hominy Baptist Church of Candler
candidates.note: School-age summer childcare runs mid-June–mid-August with swimming and field trips; its current page does not specify a summer year.

candidates.name: Emmanuel Lutheran Church and School of Asheville
candidates.note: Summer Rocks offers weekly camps for rising grades 1–6, including arts, athletics, LEGO engineering, cooking and science.

candidates.name: Groce United Methodist Church of Asheville
candidates.note: Music camp for ages 5–12 includes crafts, recreation and lunch; the 2026 session ran July 13–17, 10 a.m.–3 p.m.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Asheville
candidates.note: FirstShine is a single four-day camp, not recurring weekly care, for teens and young adults with special needs; July 27–30, 2026, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.
